meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Zr I lines from Biémont et al. 1981 (38 lines): lifetime, branching ratio R and f transcribed from the ADS scan; each line was checked by matching lower + wavenumber(printed air wavelength) to a NIST odd level with the printed J, by recomputing f from R/tau, and by comparison with the log gf of the same paper in the Kurucz file gf4000bghl.lab. A_s = R/tau (derived). A second set of 70+ ultraviolet lines carries semi-empirical A values (method "theory": experimental lifetime of Malcheva 2009 x HFR branching fraction, taken second-hand from the Kurucz file gf4000mmor.lab). Malcheva 2009 lifetimes were read from the publisher HTML page through a text-extraction tool; three of them agree with the Biémont values quoted on the same page. Level energies, J and labels are from the NIST levels file.
